comment: Pinned environments for candidate QA. tools/qa.sh and the release workflow read the userland images from here. Change a digest only on purpose, and record the change with the next candidate's results.

isolation.comment: strace is installed from Debian's archive when the check runs

ssh.comment: openssh-server is installed from Alpine's archive when the check runs

arch.comment: The release workflow builds the recipe in a devtools clean chroot inside this image. Its pacman.conf has NoExtract = usr/share/doc/*, so installed documents are checked from the package payload and from an install with that rule removed.

nixos.comment: flake.lock pins this revision; the NixOS checks boot it under QEMU with KVM in CI.

baseline.comment: The oldest kernel line the pinned nixpkgs still ships, booted in a NixOS VM on QEMU's qemu64 CPU model, which lacks SSE4.1, SSE4.2, and POPCNT and so stays below x86-64-v2. nix/baseline-test.nix checks both.
